Sixteen matcaps picked from github.com/nidorx/matcaps (the /256 folder),
a collection gathered from the ZBrush Central matcap repository, Pixologic's
library and BadKing. Its README gives no single licence and says the original
authors could not be traced; the filenames there are the images' main colours.
Treat these as "free to use, provenance unknown" until each one is traced.
